data.user_prompt: Which companies help businesses in the UAE get ready for e-invoicing? List up to 6 with their websites.

sections.text:
With the UAE rolling out its mandatory electronic invoicing framework (mandated to go live in phases), several pre-approved and officially accredited service providers (ASPs) are assisting local businesses. These companies provide Peppol-compliant integration, API solutions, and compliance testing to help organizations connect their ERP systems seamlessly. 

Here are six companies helping businesses in the UAE get ready for e-invoicing:

### 1. InvoiceNow Biz
A fully Ministry of Finance (MoF) accredited e-invoicing service provider operating its own specialized `eInvoiceXchange` platform. It offers end-to-end integration, consulting, and free introductory tiers for testing and piloting.
* **Website:** [invoicenow.biz](https://www.invoicenow.biz)

### 2. ClearTax
An AI-native compliance technology platform. It is recognized as one of the prominent fully approved ASPs in the UAE, providing real-time data validation and integration for enterprise accounting systems.
* **Website:** [cleartax.in](https://cleartax.in)

### 3. EDICOM
A global EDI and electronic invoicing platform officially accredited by the UAE Ministry of Finance. EDICOM assists large-scale and multinational enterprises with continuous transaction controls (CTC) and Peppol standard integration.
* **Website:** [edicomgroup.com](https://www.edicomgroup.com)

### 4. SunTec Business Solutions
An accredited service provider listed on the FTA EmaraTax portal. SunTec's *Xelerate E-Invoicing* software helps UAE businesses automate their compliance operations, manage high-volume invoice routing, and avoid tax penalties.
* **Website:** [suntecgroup.com](https://www.suntecgroup.com)

### 5. Complyance.io
Complyance acts as a dedicated middleware service, integrating POS, billing systems, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems directly with tax authorities via the Peppol network. 
* **Website:** [complyance.io](https://complyance.io)

### 6. Business Experts MEA (BEMEA)
An enterprise IT consulting and systems integrator specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365. BEMEA assists UAE organizations with their e-invoicing strategy, connecting internal ERP architectures with approved ASP networks for smooth tax clearance.
* **Website:** [bemea.com](https://www.bemea.com)
